projects.title: Data Free Browsing
projects.description: Worked on a 5-person team to build an android app that could fetch Wikipedia articles, directions from Google Maps, and Translate phrases with Microsoft Azure, all without a data connection. This was done by setting up a Twilio webhook built with Python’s Flask framework hosted on a cloud server that would handle all the requests over SMS. Android, Python, Flask, Twilio, Azure, Google Maps API.
